in_marathi.name: Sharanappa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Protector, God of Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharanappa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharanappa is a name derived from the Sanskrit words 'shara' meaning protection and 'anna' meaning father or god. It is a name that signifies the protector of the earth and the provider of peace and prosperity. In Hindu mythology, Sharanappa is also known as Bhoo Devata, the god of the earth.
